name: Gries Café
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gries Café in Prägraten am Großvenediger**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a stone’s throw from the majestic **Großvenediger**, **Gries Café** invites you to savor the warmth of traditional alpine hospitality. Whether you’re seeking a hearty breakfast to fuel your adventures or a cozy break after a day of hiking, our rustic charm and homemade delights will leave you enchanted.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit compote or a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** fondue, melted to perfection with crispy bread and local white wine. For the sweet tooth, our **Apfelstrudel**—warm, spiced, and filled with tart apples—is a must-try.

After your meal, step outside and breathe in the crisp mountain air. The views of the **Hohe Tauern** and the **Venediger Group** are nothing short of breathtaking. Whether you’re planning a hike to the **Karkopf** or simply unwinding with a book, **Gries Café** is your perfect retreat in the **Pitztal**.

Come visit us—where every bite tells a story of **Tirol**’s rich traditions. We look forward to welcoming you!
